tagline: Where Every Cup Tells a Story
heroSubtitle: Artisan coffee, freshly baked pastries, and a warm atmosphere in the heart of the city.

about.title: Our Story
about.intro: Born from a passion for exceptional coffee and a love of community.
story: Café Regina was founded in 2018 by two friends who shared a dream: to create a space where great coffee meets genuine hospitality. What started as a small corner café has grown into a beloved neighborhood destination.

Our name, 'Regina,' means 'queen' — a tribute to the art of coffee-making and our commitment to treating every guest like royalty. We believe that a perfect cup of coffee can transform an ordinary moment into something extraordinary.

Every bean we use is ethically sourced from small-batch farms around the world. Our roasters work closely with farmers in Colombia, Ethiopia, Guatemala, and beyond to ensure the highest quality and fairest practices.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
philosophy.text: We believe in the power of simplicity. Great ingredients, careful preparation, and genuine warmth — that's all it takes to create something truly special. At Café Regina, we don't rush. We take time to craft every drink, plate every dish with care, and make every guest feel at home.

values.title: Quality First
values.description: We never compromise on ingredients. From single-origin beans to locally sourced produce, quality is our foundation.

values.title: Community
values.description: We're more than a café — we're a gathering place. We host local artists, support neighborhood events, and foster genuine connections.

values.title: Sustainability
values.description: From compostable packaging to energy-efficient equipment, we're committed to reducing our environmental footprint.
